# 1 Enoch Chapter 107 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Birth of Noah (Appendix)

---

**1** After that, I explained to Methuselah all the hidden things in the books of Enoch — all the parables that had been revealed to me through them — and I summed it all up for him.

**2** And he went back and gave the child the name Noah. Because this child will bring comfort to the earth after all the destruction.

**3** After the flood, another son was born to him, named Nir. And all the mysteries about what was coming — the destruction that would arrive during the generation over which Nir and his son would rule — were revealed to Noah.

---

*PNEUMA notes: V. 2's etymology is the key: Noah (from nuah, to rest or comfort) will be the earth's consolation after the flood. This connects to the naming in Genesis 5:29 — the parents hoped the child would bring rest from their labor, and Enoch's revelation confirms it on a cosmic scale. The brief mention of Nir in v. 3 opens a door to a larger tradition — the reader is left wondering about this second son and the destruction in his days.*
